CustomField.formula: CASE(Sub_Category__c, "Sales Mail", "Sales Retention", "Service Mail", "Service Retention", "Search", "Digital Fees", "Display", "Digital Fees", "Social", "Digital Fees", "Video", "Digital Fees", "Text", "Website", "Package Fees", if(Text(Main_Category__c) = "Website", "Website", if(Text(Main_Category__c) = "Digital", "Digital Fees", if(Contains(Contract_Product_Name__c, "CXP"), "CXP", if(Contains(Contract_Product_Name__c, "Sport Bundle") || Contains(Contract_Product_Name__c, "Touring Bundle") || Contains(Contract_Product_Name__c, "Advance Bundle") || Contains(Contract_Product_Name__c, "A-Spec Website"), "Website", if(Text(Main_Category__c) = "Retention", "Sales Retention", "ERROR"))))) , "Agency Fees", "Agency Fees", "Fees", "Packages", "Other", "Packages", TEXT(Sub_Category__c))
CustomField.label: Reporting Categories
